body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

However, this will not work on imported 3D scenes (Collada/glTF/FBX) because they specify the texture filter based on metadata in the source file. I suggest we add an import option to these scene formats so that you can force a specific texture filter on all materials used in the scene:

- Use Source Filter (default, `-2`)
- Project Default (`-1`)
- Nearest (`0`)
- Nearest Mipmaps (`1`)
- ...

You'll then be able to force the project texture filter by changing it to **Project Default** in the Import dock. (We probably need to keep existing behavior as-is to preserve compatibility with existing projects.)

Also, please update the class reference and fill in the descriptions so that CI passes. See [Contributing to the class reference](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/contributing/documentation/updating_the_class_reference.html) for more information.
